title: Nuclear silo shutdowns and anti-nuclear messaging

tellings.quote: lot of a lot of the nuclear stuff is like shutting down silos and maybe and then a lot of the messaging that people get seems to be like you're going to destroy yourselves in some sort of nuclear holocaust

plain: Many UFO accounts from nuclear sites describe nuclear missiles in their silos being shut down, and many people who say they were contacted report a message that humans will destroy themselves in a nuclear war. Michels puts these two things together himself, citing the researcher Robert Hastings, who has collected accounts of UFOs at nuclear bases. If the pattern holds, it would suggest whoever is behind it is worried about nuclear weapons.
